parameters.name: AddEntry
parameters.description: The entries to add or modify in the port range list.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the port range. The description must be 2 to 32 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://. Valid values of N: 0 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The port range. Valid values of N: 0 to 200. Settings:

- The number of entries cannot exceed the maximum entry capacity (`MaxEntries`).

- You cannot specify duplicate values for `PortRange`.

- The value cannot be the same as the value of the `RemoveEntry.N.PortRange` parameter.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the port range list. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: PortRangeListId
parameters.description: The ID of the port range list to modify.

parameters.name: PortRangeListName
parameters.description: The name of the port range list. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http://, https://, com.aliyun, or com.alibabacloud. It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the port range list. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RemoveEntry
parameters.description: The entries to delete from the port range list.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The port range. Valid values of N: 0 to 200. Settings:

- You cannot specify duplicate values for `PortRange`.

- The value cannot be the same as the value of the `AddEntry.N.PortRange` parameter.
